entry.title: Routing agents now move dock appointments
entry.summary:
Routing agents now move a dock appointment on their own when a carrier runs late, and the warehouse and the carrier both see the new slot.

Turn it on per warehouse in Dock settings.

entry.title: Shipment data straight from your ERP
entry.summary: Shipment data from customer ERPs now flows into Northwind through one pipeline, so a new shipper sees every lane live on the first day.

entry.title: Exception alerts in Microsoft Teams
entry.summary: Exception alerts can now go to a Microsoft Teams channel as well as Slack, with the reason a load drifted off its ETA and a suggested fix.
